products.name: Deepgram
products.note: Speech recognition API; real-time transcription; model customization; on-prem option

profile_text.body:
Deepgram is a San Francisco-based company that provides voice AI infrastructure for enterprise applications. Its platform centers on speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent APIs, and the company describes itself as "the industry's voice AI leader." It positions its offering around unifying those three components, along with LLM orchestration, into a single API rather than requiring customers to connect separate services, with stated goals of reducing complexity, latency, and cost.

The company's products include real-time transcription, model customization, and an on-premises deployment option. A recently introduced text-to-speech model called Flux TTS is described on the site as "the first voice model that thinks before it speaks," holding tone, expression, and continuity across a conversation. Deepgram noted a free build period for Flux TTS through September 12th, with up to 45 concurrent streaming connections available in the US and 5 in the EU and Australia. The site also references an integration with Amazon Connect.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server listings for Deepgram. The company has a tracked profile on theworldofai.org, verified as of August 31, 2026.
